separates deterministic common inputs from implementation scripts
includes smoke, dry-run, and full-run commands
uses runner metrics for runtime and memory
requires correctness checks before ranking speed

output_quality_evals.prompt: The generated benchmark README has timing but no memory column; diagnose the harness.

inspects summarizer mapping from job names to memory metrics

output_quality_evals.prompt: Update benchmark docs after a new run without overwriting manual README sections.
assertions: preserves manual README content outside markers
records source run path and UTC generation time
